tour_type.morning: 🏛️ Brandenburg Gate: Start the day at one of Europe’s most iconic landmarks, huge, historic and photogenic. → | 🏢 Reichstag (Glass Dome): A modern dome with a spiral walkway and panoramic city views. Advance time slots recommended, but worth it. → | 🕊️ Holocaust Memorial: A quiet, reflective maze of concrete blocks with a respectful atmosphere. → | ☕ Coffee at Potsdamer Platz: Modern architecture and a morning break in one place.
tour_type.afternoon: 🎨 East Side Gallery: A long stretch of the Berlin Wall turned into an open-air art gallery full of color and meaning. → | 🧱 Berlin Wall Museum: Clear exhibits explaining history in an accessible, youth-friendly way. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Berlin Specialties: Currywurst with mild options, pretzels, vegetarian döner and potato dishes, classic Berlin comfort food. → | 🏙️ Alexanderplatz: Famous central square with shops, street performers and the TV Tower skyline.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Museum Island Riverside Walk or Oberbaum Bridge View: Soft golden light over the Spree River, perfect for photos and calm moments.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Kreuzberg Evening: Youth-friendly cafés, creative spaces, live-music corners and street-food courts with plenty of non-alcoholic drinks.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🏛️ Brandenburg Gate: Begin at one of Europe’s most powerful landmarks with massive columns and a lively city atmosphere. → | 🏢 Reichstag (Glass Dome): Walk up to the futuristic dome for 360° views over Berlin. Booking a time slot makes it easier. → | 🕊️ Holocaust Memorial: Walk through rows of concrete stelae and take a quiet moment of reflection. → | ☕ Coffee at Potsdamer Platz: Enjoy a break among glass towers and modern city lines.; Afternoon: 🎨 East Side Gallery: Discover the former Berlin Wall covered in murals and creativity. → | 🧱 Berlin Wall Museum (East Side): Learn about the city's divided past through clear, youth-friendly exhibits. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Berlin Specialties: Try currywurst, soft pretzels, vegetarian döner or potato dishes. → | 🏙️ Alexanderplatz: Explore shops, modern architecture and views of the TV Tower.; Sunset: 🌅 Museum Island Riverside or Oberbaum Bridge: Stroll by the water in golden light over bridges and historic scenery.; Night: 🌃 Kreuzberg Evening: End the day in creative neighborhoods with cafés, street food and safe nightlife without alcohol.

tour_type.morning: 🏙️ Marienplatz: Begin in Munich’s beating heart with a lively square, historic atmosphere and iconic architecture. → | 🏛️ New Town Hall & Glockenspiel: Watch the mechanical show and enjoy panoramic views from the tower. → | 🛒 Viktualienmarkt Walk: Colorful market with fresh snacks, fruit, pastries and local bites. → | ☕ Coffee at a Central Café: Cozy Bavarian ambiance to recharge for the day.
tour_type.afternoon: 🏰 Nymphenburg Palace Tour: Grand halls, royal rooms and a quiet escape from the city buzz. → | 🌿 Palace Gardens Stroll: Lakes, bridges and long leafy paths for gentle walks and photos. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Bavarian Specialties: Pretzels, käsespätzle, potato dishes, soups and plenty of vegetarian options.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 English Garden Sunset: Relax by the water or head to the Monopteros viewpoint for warm sky colors and nature scenes.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Student District Evenings: Chill cafés, dessert spots and safe, calm walks around the Old Town for winding down.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🏙️ Marienplatz: Start in Munich’s iconic square with historic façades, lively energy and photo-ready angles. → | 🏛️ New Town Hall & Glockenspiel: Catch the show, then go up the tower for wide views over rooftops and spires, with the Alps on clear days. → | 🛒 Viktualienmarkt Walk: Browse fresh fruit, pastries, local snacks and Bavarian specialties for a light bite. → | ☕ Coffee at a Central Café: Take a relaxed break in a cozy Old Town café.; Afternoon: 🏰 Nymphenburg Palace: Explore elegant halls, royal chambers and a calm, majestic atmosphere. → | 🌿 Palace Gardens Stroll: Wander lakes, bridges and leafy alleys across scenic green spaces. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Bavarian Specialties: Enjoy käsespätzle, pretzels, potato dishes, hearty soups or vegetarian Bavarian meals.; Sunset: 🌅 English Garden (Englischer Garten): Watch golden light by the lakeside or from Monopteros hill for one of Munich’s prettiest views.; Night: 🌃 Student District Evenings: Finish with relaxed cafés, dessert spots or a gentle Old Town stroll for a calm, friendly night.

tour_type.morning: 🏰 Zwinger Palace: A masterpiece of Baroque architecture with grand courtyards, fountains and beautiful galleries. → | 🎨 Old Masters Gallery: Home to world-famous artworks, including Raphael’s ‘Sistine Madonna’. → | 🎭 Theaterplatz Walk: Classic Dresden scenery with the Semperoper and Hofkirche nearby. → | ☕ Coffee near Semperoper: Relax with a morning drink on an elegant square.
tour_type.afternoon: ⛪ Frauenkirche: A stunning church rebuilt stone-by-stone, a symbol of Dresden’s resilience. → | 🌉 Brühl’s Terrace (Balcony of Europe): Scenic views over the Elbe, perfect for photos. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Saxon Specialties: Traditional dishes with the famous Dresdner Eierschecke dessert.

tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Zwinger Palace: Begin in one of Europe’s finest Baroque complexes with sculpted fountains, ornate façades and elegant galleries. → | 🎨 Old Masters Gallery: Admire Renaissance and Baroque masterpieces, including works by Raphael, Rembrandt, Vermeer and Titian. → | 🎭 Theaterplatz Walk: Stroll through an iconic square framed by the Semperoper, Hofkirche and classical architecture. → | ☕ Coffee near Semperoper: Enjoy a relaxed drink surrounded by historic scenery.; Afternoon: ⛪ Frauenkirche: Visit the church rebuilt stone-by-stone after World War II, a powerful symbol of peace. → | 🌉 Brühl’s Terrace (Balcony of Europe): Walk the elevated riverside promenade with sweeping Elbe views. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Saxon Specialties: Try hearty regional dishes and finish with the Dresdner Eierschecke cake.; Sunset: 🌅 Elbe River or Augustus Bridge Viewpoint: Watch golden reflections ripple across the river as the skyline glows.; Night: 🌃 Neustadt Creative District or Riverside Night Walk: Enjoy artsy streets, dessert cafés or a calm Elbe-side stroll for a peaceful finish.

tour_type.full_day: Morning: ⛪ Cologne Cathedral: Admire the Gothic masterpiece in early light. → | 🏛️ Old Town Streets: Wander colorful houses and cobbled lanes. → | 🌉 Hohenzollern Bridge: See love locks and passing trains with great views. → | ☕ Riverside Coffee Break.; Afternoon: 🎨 Museum Ludwig: Explore modern art in bright galleries. → | 🌊 Rheinpromenade: Enjoy wide paths and fresh river air. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Local and Vegetarian Options: Choose from soups, pretzels, potato dishes and pastries.; Sunset: 🌅 Rheinboulevard Deutz: Watch the skyline glow from the riverside steps.; Night: 🌃 Old Town and Chocolate Museum Area: Finish with desserts, reflections on the Rhine and peaceful illuminated streets.

interest_descriptions.History & Landmarks 🏰: Explore Hannover’s grand town hall, medieval corners, half-timbered houses and historically rich city squares.
interest_descriptions.Parks & Nature 🌳: Enjoy peaceful large parks, forests, gardens and shaded walking paths throughout the greenest parts of the city.
interest_descriptions.Urban Culture 🎭: Experience cool modern districts, creative neighborhoods, street art spots and relaxed cultural areas.
interest_descriptions.Lakes & Scenic Views 🌊: Walk around Maschsee and nearby lakes, enjoy water reflections and calm breezy areas perfect for unwinding.
interest_descriptions.Art & Museums 🎨: Visit top-level art museums, modern design spaces, sculpture gardens and creative contemporary galleries.
interest_descriptions.Food Exploration 😋: Taste warm German dishes, pastries, potato meals, bakeries, international bowls and plenty of vegetarian options.
interest_descriptions.Photography 📸: Capture reflections, elegant gardens, skyline views, lake sunsets and beautiful architectural contrasts.

food_descriptions.Local Specialties: Comforting German dishes such as soups, potato-based meals, pastries and mild regional classics.
food_descriptions.Fast Food: Bakery snacks, sandwiches, pretzels, wraps and easy quick meals in the city center.
food_descriptions.Vegetarian: Veggie bowls, salads, soups, pasta, potatoes and plant-friendly options widely available.
food_descriptions.Mixed Options: A blend of local and international foods ideal for flexible preferences.

tour_type.morning: 🏰 New Town Hall (Neues Rathaus): Start your day at Hannover’s palace-like landmark with stunning architecture, a lakeside setting and a curved elevator leading to a panoramic dome view. → | 🌿 Maschpark Walk: Quiet paths around the reflective lake with bridges, flowers and green lawns. → | 🏙️ Old Town Streets: Half-timbered houses, small lanes, cozy squares and a relaxed historic vibe. → | ☕ Coffee in the Historic Center: Warm, peaceful break in charming surroundings.
tour_type.afternoon: 🎨 Herrenhausen Gardens: A masterpiece of Baroque design with fountains, long alleys, symmetry and sculptures. → | 🌊 Maschsee Lake Promenade: Wide lakeside paths with fresh air, water reflections and calm walking space. → | 🍽️ Lunch: German comfort food, potato dishes, pastries and easy vegetarian options.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Maschsee Pier Area: Soft golden reflections across the lake with silhouettes of trees and boats.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Old Town and Kröpcke Evening Walk: Bright pedestrian streets, illuminated shop fronts and dessert cafés in a safe, friendly atmosphere.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🏰 New Town Hall: Enjoy impressive architecture and a dome lookout with panoramic views. → | 🌿 Maschpark: Walk through calm lakeside greenery for morning photos. → | 🏙️ Old Town Streets: Explore half-timbered charm and peaceful corners. → | ☕ Coffee Break in the Historic Center.; Afternoon: 🎨 Herrenhausen Gardens: Wander Baroque alleys, fountains and elegant scenery. → | 🌊 Maschsee Lake Promenade: Take a wide, breezy waterfront walk. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Local and Vegetarian Options: Choose potato dishes, pastries and light bowls.; Sunset: 🌅 Maschsee Pier: Watch golden-hour reflections over the water.; Night: 🌃 Kröpcke and Old Town: Finish with soft lights, dessert spots and relaxed pedestrian zones.
